source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Under AMI RU tool, Check should show FF in Memory Address FEC10000
2. Check Register in UEFI SHELL.
     CMD: "pci 0 14 3"
     It should show FF FF FF FF in address 000000A0.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Response should be the same as AMI Armor user guide.
2. It should be human readable.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- Check AMI Armor Register: read the AMI Armor register values. Agent reads the OS-visible SMBIOS/BCP info sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "ls /sys/firmware/efi/efivars/ 2>&1 | grep -i armor; dmesg 2>&1 | grep -i armor | tail -n 10 2>&1"; the register read (AMI RU tool / UEFI Shell `pci 0 14 3` at 0x000000A0 = FF FF FF FF) must be done in the pre-OS AMI RU/UEFI Shell by an operator.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return the OS-visible armor-related info + the operator must provide the RU/pci register dump (FEC10000 = FF, addr 0xA0 = FF FF FF FF) so the user verifies against the AMI Armor guide.

original_test_intent: Verify the platform-specific AMI Armor memory/register values at FEC10000 and the documented `pci 0 14 3` offset A0 against the exact AMI Armor guide, with readable direct output.
original_method: An operator runs approved read-only AMI RU and UEFI Shell register views, captures full output and target bytes, and compares them to the platform guide; OS evidence only corroborates identity and health.
manual_activity: The acceptance-critical AMI RU/UEFI register read and readable output observation occur in pre-OS tools and are operator-only; the agent may analyze supplied dumps.
required_inputs: Meaning and mapping of FEC10000 and `pci 0 14 3`/A0
safety_requirements: Confirm commands are read-only; never setpci, write registers or probe guessed addresses.
Do not infer target bytes from EFI-variable names or dmesg.
Preserve full output and bind it to platform/tool/guide version.
Stop on ambiguous target, unexpected bytes, truncated output or health loss; no alternate-address probing or retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect supporting platform/firmware/OS identity and health, parse the operator's full register dump and compare exact offsets/bytes with the supplied guide.
Do not claim pre-OS execution, live readability or final verdict.
engineer_actions: Run and capture the documented RU/UEFI read-only operations and verify output readability.
RD/owner validates the platform-specific mapping and issues the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The OS grep is not evidence of the required register values; the pre-OS command must remain operator-executed and guide-bound.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use only the documented AMI RU/UEFI reads manually, then analyze the full capture offline; no OS substitute command is recommended.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The named addresses, command, expected FF values and 10/10-minute values are retained pending guide validation.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture full pre-OS register context with tool/platform versions and automatically verify byte positions in the supplied artifact against the approved guide.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Only the board/BIOS explicitly covered by the AMI Armor guide.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record board, BIOS/BMC, RU/UEFI tool and guide versions.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds provenance and machine-checkable artifact comparison without replacing pre-OS observation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Prevents correct-looking FF bytes from the wrong address/device from passing.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: OS-visible data cannot prove these pre-OS values; any write-capable tool must remain in read-only mode.

project_override_considerations: A project may provide revision-specific addresses or expectations, but cannot silently reuse these literals on another platform; deviations require an approved case override.
expected_evidence: Full UEFI `pci 0 14 3` output and A0 bytes

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source is explicit; platform-specific interpretation must be confirmed by the required guide.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The operator can execute the clear pre-OS procedure once documentation is supplied; core manual execution makes it MANUAL ONLY.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Rejects OS greps as proof and retains only artifact support.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Keeps exact-target/no-write protections but changes to MANUAL ONLY because the required register observation is the core acceptance.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Distinguishes offline analysis from execution of the pre-OS test.

review_improvement: Prevents an OS keyword hit or FF bytes from an unrelated location from being reported as AMI Armor compliance.
independent_technical_reasoning: The source tests exact platform-specific register contents in pre-OS tools; supporting host text neither addresses those locations nor proves the human-readable live output, so the manual read remains the acceptance core.
